name: relativistic_speed_limit
description: No physical body with non-zero mass can achieve or exceed the speed of light in vacuum.

name: positive_mass_theorem
description: Inertial and gravitational mass must be strictly non-negative in classical and relativistic mechanics.

name: first_law_thermodynamics
description: Total energy in an isolated system is conserved; energy output cannot exceed energy input without external generation.

name: third_law_thermodynamics
description: Thermodynamic temperature of a system cannot fall below absolute zero (0 Kelvin).

name: classical_dynamics
description: The net external force on a body is directly proportional to its mass and resultant acceleration.

name: electrical_power_dissipation
description: Rate of electrical energy dissipation in a conductor equals voltage times current.

name: carnot_efficiency_limit
description: Maximum thermal engine efficiency is fundamentally bounded by operating reservoir temperatures.

name: rocket_thrust_equation
description: Reaction force generated by propellant expulsion equals mass flow rate multiplied by exhaust velocity.
